description: Search agent benchmark suite – 17 test cases covering the complete end-to-end search workflow. Covers: intent classification, router redirection, missing fields handling, vendor filtering, multi-turn deep analysis, modification, reset, workflow navigation (skip/proceed/confirm), and all sub-agent pipelines. Tests 001-010 are single-turn; tests 011-017 cover multi-turn workflows and workflow step transitions. search_011→012 form a paired sequence (share session bench_da_001) to test the full deep analysis pipeline; search_013→014 form a paired sequence (share session bench_mt_001) to test missing-fields recovery.

test_cases.name: Simple – Complete Pressure Transmitter Requirements
test_cases.description: Baseline case. Complete specs for a pressure transmitter. Validates the full pipeline: search_intent → extract_requirements → validation_agent → generate_final_response → summary_agent.

input.user_query: I need a differential pressure transmitter with 0-500 mbar range, 4-20mA HART output, 1/2 inch NPT connection, and stainless steel wetted parts.

test_cases.name: Simple – Incomplete Requirements Triggering Missing Fields
test_cases.description: User provides incomplete specs. Validates that the workflow correctly identifies missing mandatory fields through the validation sub-agent and generates a missing fields response.

input.user_query: I am looking for a temperature transmitter with 4-20mA output.

test_cases.name: Simple – Temperature Transmitter with Basic Specs
test_cases.description: User requests a temperature transmitter with basic specifications. Validates the full pipeline with a known product type: search_intent → extract_requirements → validation_agent → generate_final_response → summary_agent.

input.user_query: I need a temperature transmitter with -20 to 100°C range and 4-20mA output.

test_cases.name: Medium – Vendor Strategy Filtering
test_cases.description: User provides a procurement strategy to filter vendors. Validates that the full pipeline runs including vendor strategy filtering.

input.user_query: I need a level transmitter, guided wave radar, 0-10m range, 4-20mA with HART, using our standard vendor strategy for off-shore platforms.

test_cases.name: Medium – Discovery with Advanced Specs Agent
test_cases.description: Tests the full pipeline with advanced specs discovery. Validates that validation_agent runs all internal sub-steps.

input.user_query: I need a Coriolis flow meter for liquid service, DN50 size, 4-20mA HART, with diagnostic capabilities and advanced multiphase specs.

test_cases.name: Complex – Deep Analysis Multi-Vendor Pressure Transmitter
test_cases.description: Complete requirements with multiple vendor candidates. Validates the full pipeline including deep analysis for parallel vendor comparison of pressure transmitters.

input.user_query: Find me a pressure transmitter for process control. Needs absolute pressure range 0-10 bar, 4-20mA HART output, flange connection, 316 stainless steel, and digital display. Look for Emerson and ABB models.

test_cases.name: Simple – Flow Meter with Minimal Specs
test_cases.description: User requests a flow meter with minimal specifications. Validates that incomplete product query triggers validation and missing fields response.

input.user_query: I need a flow meter for a pipeline.

test_cases.name: Contextual QNA Intent Detection
test_cases.description: User asks a contextual question about a previous product result. Tests that the agent correctly classifies the query as contextual_qna. The agent returns early inside classify_search_intent so only search_intent is appended to agent_path before generate_final_response/summary_agent.

input.user_query: What is the accuracy of the first Emerson product?

test_cases.name: Simple – Temperature Transmitter Basic Request
test_cases.description: User requests a temperature transmitter with basic specification. Validates that the agent correctly identifies the product type and initiates the search workflow.

input.user_query: I'm looking for a temperature transmitter with 0-100°C range and 4-20mA output.

test_cases.name: Very Complex – Extreme Specs with Full Pipeline
test_cases.description: Tests the complete search workflow with all sub-agents running: advanced_specs_agent, deep_analysis_agent, and summary_agent.

input.user_query: Identify electromagnetic flow meters for chemical slurry applications, DN100 flange, Hastelloy C electrodes, PTFE lining, ATEX certified, 4-20mA FF, with SIL 2 certification and local display. Evaluate for Endress+Hauser and Yokogawa.

test_cases.name: Multi-turn Turn 1 – Complete Specs to Establish Session
test_cases.description: Turn 1 of a 2-turn deep-analysis workflow. Provides complete gauge pressure transmitter specs so validation passes and the agent shows a summary/confirmation message. The benchmark runner persists search params in conversation memory for session bench_da_001, enabling search_012 to trigger deep analysis in the next turn.

input.user_query: I need a gauge pressure transmitter, 0-10 bar range, 4-20mA HART output, 1/2 inch NPT process connection, 316L stainless steel wetted parts, ATEX Zone 1 rated, operating temperature -20 to 85°C.

test_cases.name: Multi-turn Turn 2 – Confirm Search → Deep Analysis
test_cases.description: Turn 2 of the deep-analysis workflow. User confirms the search at showSummary step. The agent classifies as workflow/finalAnalysis, loads search params from conversation memory (stored by search_011), and executes the full deep analysis pipeline: detect_product_type → filter_vendors → search_products → load_pdf_content → discover_specs → format_requirements → perform_deep_analysis → generate_final_response. MUST run after search_011 (shares session bench_da_001).

test_cases.name: Multi-turn Turn 1 – Incomplete Vortex Flow Meter
test_cases.description: Turn 1 of a missing-fields recovery workflow. User provides incomplete vortex flow meter specs (missing pipe size and temperature range). The agent validates requirements, identifies missing mandatory fields, responds with a missing-fields message, and stores partial search params in session bench_mt_001 for search_014.

input.user_query: I need a vortex flow meter for steam service with 4-20mA HART output and flanged connection.

test_cases.name: Multi-turn Turn 2 – Provide Missing Fields
test_cases.description: Turn 2 of the missing-fields recovery workflow. User provides the previously missing specs (pipe size and temperature range) at the awaitMissingInfo step. The agent classifies as modification, applies the changes, and responds with an update summary. MUST run after search_013 (shares session bench_mt_001).

input.user_query: The pipe size is DN80, operating temperature range is 150°C to 350°C.

test_cases.name: Reset Intent – Start Fresh
test_cases.description: User explicitly asks to clear all requirements and start a new search. Validates that the agent correctly classifies the request as reset, asks for confirmation, and ends the workflow without executing any search logic.

input.user_query: Actually, forget everything. Let's start over with a completely different product.

test_cases.name: Workflow Navigation – Skip Missing Fields to Advanced Specs
test_cases.description: User is at the awaitMissingInfo step and chooses to skip providing missing fields and proceed to the advanced specifications discovery step. Validates that the agent classifies this as workflow navigation with next_step=awaitAdditionalAndLatestSpecs and generates the appropriate transition message.

input.user_query: Skip, just proceed with what we have.

test_cases.name: Workflow Navigation – Advanced Specs to Summary
test_cases.description: User is at the awaitAdvancedSpecs step and chooses to skip advanced spec selection and move to the summary. Validates that the agent classifies as workflow navigation with next_step=showSummary and generates a summary transition message.
